paite: Huchi in Israel suan om khawmte tengteng akisata ua, pheikhai lual in Dan a pan Beer-sheba kho pha in Gilead gam a mite toh Mizpah ah TOUPA kiang ah akikhawm uhi.
heading: Galdou Ding In Israel Akisakhol

paite: Mi tengteng heutu, Israel chite tengteng Pathian mite kikhopkhawmna ah atel ua, sepaih namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uhi.
Benjamin suante'n Israel suante Mizpah ah ahohtou uh chih aza ua, Israel suante'n, "Bangchidan a hichibang a gitlouhna hong om ahia, hon hilh un?" achi uhi.
Levi chi, athah uh numei pasal in, "Benjamin chite omna Gibeah ah ka mei toh giak ding in ka va lut uhi.
Gibeah mite'n ahong sualta ua, zan in inn ahong um ua; hon thah atum ua, ka mei apawngsual ua asita hi.
Huchi in ka mei luang ka sem a, Israelte gam luah tengteng ah ka khak a, Israel gam ah thilkihhuai leh haihuaitak ana hihta ngal ua.
Nou Israel suante aw, na vek un ngai un, na ngaihdan uleh pha na sakdan uh gen dih ua," achi hi.
Huchi in mi tengteng pheikhai lual in athou ua, “Kuamah i puanin lam ah i pai het kei ding, kuamah i inn ah i lut kei ding uh.
Gibeahte i bawldan ding hichibang ahi. Ai i san ding ua, amaute i dou ding uh.
Gibeah mun a Benjaminte i va sualna ua mipite nek ding pe ding in Israel nam tengteng lak a mi zakhat ah sawmkhat zel, sangkhat ah zakhat zel, singkhat ah sangkhat zel i telkhe ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng pheikhai lual in huai khopi sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
Israel namte'n Benjamin nam tengteng kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na lak ua na hih uh bang gitlouhna ahia?
Gibeah a mi Belial tate hon pi unla, Israel gam a gitlouhna adaihtheihna ding in ka na that ding uh," chi in mi asawl uhi. Himahleh Benjamin chite'n a-unau Israel suante thugen azui nuam kei uh.
Benjamin suante bel Israel suante dou ding in khopite a pan ahong pawtkhawm ua, Gibeah ah alutta uhi.
Huai ni a Benjamin suante khopi a pan namsau tawi a pawtte, Gibeah a mi zasagih telkhiakte sim louh in singnih-le-sangguk ahi uh.
Huai tengteng lak ah veilong zasagih, telkhiak a-om ua; amaute'n vaisuangseh in samzang chia leng akhial kei uhi.
Israel mite, Benjamin mite sim louh in namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uh. Amau tengteng galdou thei vek ahi uh.
Israel suante athou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, Pathian ava dong ua, Benjamin suante kua'n ahia va sual adto masa ding? achi uh.
heading: Benjaminte Douna

paite: TOUPA'N, "Judah nam va hoh masa uhen," achi hi. Huchi in Israel suante lak ah athou ua, Gibeah khua ava umta uhi.
Israel mite Benjamin pawl sual ding in akisa ua, Israel mite'n Gibeah ah amaute sual ding in panmun akhoh uhi.
Benjamin suante Gibeah a pan apawtkhia ua, huai ni in Israel suante lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih ava that uhi.
Mipite, Israel mite akihasuan nawn ua, asual tung ni ua asualna mun mah uah sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.
Israel suante ahohtou ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in ava kap ua, "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va sual nawn un," achi hi.
Ani nih ni in Israel suante'n Benjamin suante ava naih uhi.
Benjamin suante leng huai ani nih ni in sual ding in Gibeah a pan apawt sam ua, Israel suante lak a mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ahong that nawn uh. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.

Huchi in Israel suan tengteng leh mi tengteng ava paitou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, akap ua, TOUPA ma ah atu uhi. Huai ni in nitak tan in an angawl uh. TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA adong uh (huai hun lai in huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm a-om hi).

Huai lai in Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in a-nna asem zel ahi. "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam, ka tawpsanta mai ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va hoh un; zingchiang in zaw na khut uah ka hon peta ding," achi hi.
Israel suante'n Gibeah kho kim ah tangpang mi agukkoih uhi.
Israel suante Benjamin suante sual ding in ani thum ni in akisa nawn uh. Nidang mah bang in Gibeah khua sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.

Benjamin suante bel huai mite sual ding in apawt ua, khua apawtsan uhi. Huchi in nidang mah bang in mite sual in athat pan nawnta ua, loubuk ngial ah Bethel kholam lamliante ah Israel suante sawmthum athat uhi.
Benjamin suante'n, "Ama mah bang in i ma uah azahlak nawnta uh e," achi uhi. Israel suante'n bel, "I tai ding uh, khopi a pan lamlian lam ah i tolhkhesak ding," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel suan tengteng in apanmun uh apawtsan ua, Baal Tamar mun ah panmun akhoh uhi. Israel suan aguk a na tangpangte amun ua pan, Gibeah Phaizang a panmun tan in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
Israel suante tengteng lak a telkhiak mi singkhat in ava sual ua, kidouna athupi mahmah hi. Himahleh amau thil hoih lou akiang naichik uah a-om chih athei kei uh.
TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah Benjamin suante athat hi. Israel suante'n huai ni in Benjamin suante mi singnih sangnga-le-zakhat athat uhi. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.
Huchi in Benjamin suante'n avuallelta uh chih ahong kitheita uhi. Israel suante'n Gibeah khua sual dia aguk a tangpang mite akoih uh amuan ziak un Benjamin suante anungtolh san uhi.
heading: Israelte Vualzohdan

paite: Aguk a tangpang mite'n Gibeah khua asual guih uhi. Huchi in aguk a tangpangte akiphalh ua, khua a mi tengteng namsau in asualta uhi.
Israel suante leh aguk a tangpang mite'n akichiam uh bel khopi sung a mei khuttouhsak ding, chih ahi.
Huai amuh chiang ua, Israel taikekte kilehhei a, dou ding achih uh ahi.
Huchi in khopi sung a meikhu ahong kitun nguingui tak in, Benjamin suante akihei uleh, ngai in, khopi apum in van lam tan ah akhutou ngoingoi hi.
Huchi in Israel suante ahong kilehhei ua, Benjamin suante'n lamdang asa mahmah uh. Atan uh ahoih kei ding chih lah atheita ngal ua.
Huaiziak in Israel suante ma ah gamdai ah ataikekta uh. Himahleh adelhzui pek ua, khopi a pan hong pawtte'n huai ah ana that uhi.
Benjamin suante bel a-umsip ua, adelh ua, nisuahna lam Gibeah kiang a akhawlna uah aphata uhi.
Benjamin suante mi singkhat-le- sanggiat asi ua; avek un mihat hangsan chiat ahi uh.
Akihei ua, gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah atai uh. Mi sangnga lamliante ah atom ua; Gidom tan in adelhzui ua, mi sangnih athat uhi.
Huchi in huai ni a Benjamin suan site, namsau tawimi ngen singnih-le-sangnga ahi ua, avek un mihat hangsan ahi uhi.
Mi zagukte gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah ataikek ua, huai Rimmon suangpi ah kha li sung a-om uhi.
Israel suante Benjamin suante tung ah akisa nawn ua, khopi sung a om peuhmah gante, amuhmuh uh namsau in asatlum zel ua, huai lou leng khua amuh peuhmah uh ahal zel uhi.
